command:
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
name='gen_test_s16_round2_s04'
p=Path('configs/'+name+'_quota.json')
quota=json.loads(p.read_text())
assert quota['parent_run_name']==name
assert not Path('results/'+name+'.json').exists()
assert not list(Path('logs/pbs').glob(name+'-*'))
scenes=[x['scene'] for x in quota['assignments']]
assert scenes==['FloorPlan325','FloorPlan425','FloorPlan26','FloorPlan226','FloorPlan326','FloorPlan426']
command=['python3','scripts/pbs/submit_phase.py','--task','T01','--budget-group','G01','--name',name,'--gpus','1','--walltime','00:27:10','--','python3','-u','-m','src.tools.g01_collect_parallel','--name',name,'--scenes',*scenes,'--concurrency','6','--benchmark-source','results/gen_train_concurrency_s15_02.json','--timeout-seconds','1600','--partition','test','--quota-plan',str(p),'--quota-plan-sha256',hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'--nearby-physics']
print('EXACT_SUBMISSION_COMMAND: '+json.dumps(command),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(subprocess.call(command))
